Title: NFT Hydroponic System: Slope, Flow, Spacing & Setup
Description: An NFT hydroponic system runs a thin film down a channel sloped 1–2%, at 3–5 gal/h per home channel, plants 8 in apart, pH 5.5–6.2 and EC 1.2–2.0. Free guide from HydroRigor, with figures from university and extension research.
Keywords: nft hydroponic system, hydroponics, indoor gardening, hydroponic system
